content.tagline: Professional K-beauty cosmeceuticals built on patented micro-needle and exosome delivery — for clinics, salons and distributors
content.descriptor: THREE DAYS LOVE CO., LTD., a Korean cosmeceutical company specialising in topical micro-needle (SPICUS®) and exosome delivery; brand lines ThreeDaysLove, RETURN 10, TIME 72 and the EXOMERE line
about: THREE DAYS LOVE CO., LTD. (주식회사 3일애) is a Korean cosmeceutical company that, as stated by the company, has specialised in topical “skin-implant” delivery technology since 2001. Its head office is in Seoul (Songpa-gu) with raw-material processing and R&D facilities in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. The company develops and supplies professional skincare under several of its own brand lines — ThreeDaysLove, RETURN 10 and TIME 72 — and also offers OEM/ODM manufacturing under a customer's own brand.

The company name explains its own positioning. According to THREE DAYS LOVE, the natural skin renewal cycle takes about 28 days, and its topical microneedle delivery is intended to shorten the visible response to roughly three, which is where the three days in the name comes from. The company describes its audience as people over forty who care about skin firmness, and its channels as aesthetic practices, skincare salons, wholesale, drugstores and online shops. This is the company describing its own product, not a medical statement or a promise of results.

The company's positioning is built around proprietary delivery technologies for which it reports Korean patents: SPICUS® — a plant-collagen-coated bio micro-needle for delivering actives into the skin topically, without injection (patent No. 10-2767202); EXOMERE Halla® — an exosome complex derived from Jeju Hallabong (patent No. 10-2677780); and EXO-AG® — a black-garlic and aloe-vera exosome complex (patent No. 10-2534286). As stated by the company, these technologies are intended to improve the delivery, stability and efficacy of active ingredients. The products are positioned as professional cosmeceuticals, not as medical devices or medicines.

By the company's account, quality is managed under ISO 22716 (cosmetics GMP), ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, and the range is certified or registered across a number of markets — including US MoCRA, EU CPNP and Switzerland PIF. A separate brand line, EXOMERE, appears in the company's own price list; per public data EXOMERE CO., LTD. is a distinct legal entity, and the relationship between the two companies is not independently confirmed — on this showcase the brands are not merged into a single legal entity.

lines.name: EXOMERE — the exosome line
lines.note: The company's newest brand and its principal exosome line: implant solutions, recovery balms, glutathione and ceramide care, mists, body and eye care.

lines.name: EXOMERE G — the online retail line
lines.note: A separate EXOMERE line assembled for online retail channels: the Spicus V Shot Recovery Balm cushion and targeted eye care.

lines.name: RETURN 10 — home MTS and peptide care
lines.note: A cosmeceutical line around MTS (micro-needle) solutions, peptide creams and ampoules, recovery-balm compacts and mask packs — a home-care companion to professional treatment. RETURN 10, per the company, is NMPA-registered for China.

lines.name: ThreeDaysLove — flagship cosmeceuticals
lines.note: The core professional line: recovery balms, ampoules, implant creams and targeted care built on the SPICUS® micro-needle delivery concept. Includes Recovery Balm, the Whimela Shining and Derma series, Phytobiome and scalp care.

lines.name: TIME 72 — recovery and healing
lines.note: A compact line focused on post-care recovery and soothing: AC Miracle Healer and Miracle Spongliia, and the TIME 72 EXOMERE Time Lock program kit.

tech.name: SPICUS® bio micro-needle delivery
tech.note: A plant-collagen-coated micro-needle (spicule) technology; per the company (patent No. 10-2767202), it delivers active ingredients into the skin topically — a non-injection route — while reducing irritation.

tech.name: EXOMERE Halla® and EXO-AG® exosomes
tech.note: Exosome complexes from Jeju Hallabong (patent No. 10-2677780) and from black garlic and aloe vera (patent No. 10-2534286), as reported by the company, used to support skin recovery and firmness.

tech.name: Quality systems
tech.note: Manufacturing managed under ISO 22716 (cosmetics GMP), ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, as declared by the company; copies of the ISO certificates were handed to Teranova in August 2026 and are held on file with us, and are provided to a buyer at the deal stage.

tech.name: Full-cycle OEM/ODM
tech.note: Product planning, formulation, packaging and manufacturing under a customer's own brand, with export support. Terms and minimums are confirmed via Teranova.

formats: Ampoules and MTS solutions, sets and single units
content.exportNote: As stated by the company, the range is certified or registered across several markets — including US MoCRA, EU CPNP and Switzerland PIF — and the RETURN 10 line is NMPA-registered for China; the company describes itself as certified in eight countries. The FDA MoCRA registration certificates for fiscal years 2024 and 2026 are held by Teranova and together cover 20 products. The delivery basis is FOB Korea. Final registration status for any specific market is confirmed at the deal stage.
